analysis.reason: RSI가 과매도 구간에서 반등 시작했으나, MACD 히스토그램 개선이 아직 추세 전환을 확정하기에는 미흡하다. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.79배로 위축되어 있어 방향성 확인이 필요하다. 3일 연속 관망 유지.

[모멘텀 지표]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (83,115 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (82,477/87,140/98,539 KRW): attempting short-term rise, below mid-term
· SMA100/200 (106,000/101,409 KRW) position: long-term trend weak
· 52-week position (29.6%) + current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.1→39.3): attempting to exit oversold, upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-335.1573→79.7573): improving, but trend reversal signal still weak
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band 78,132 KRW): approaching lower band, band width wide at 20.67%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (83,045 KRW): based on Pivot S1 (73,867 KRW) and 5-day low (78,000 KRW)
· Swing resistance (89,580 KRW): potential to reclaim mid-band (SMA20) if broken
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Potential Higher Low formation): possibility of recovery signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.79x): decreased confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): consider buying upon RSI rebound confirmation and increased volume

MACD histogram continues to improve, rising to 79.7573
